Identity.History: Thebes was a center of trade and commerce for the Boeotian region and much of central Greece.
Identity.Tooltip: Barter resources, establish trade routes, and recruit Advanced Thracian Black Cloak mercenaries. Upgrade in City Phase to recruit Elite Black Cloaks.

ExpandedMarket.Tooltip: Expand the Emporion to recruit Elite Thracian Black Cloak mercenaries.
